title: Dawn over Lake Lanao (Mindanao theme, instrumental)
style: Orchestral fantasy video game soundtrack in the style of Genshin Impact region exploration themes, set in Mindanao, Philippines: kulintang gong-chime playing a pentatonic melody, agung and gandingan hanging gongs, dabakan drum rhythms, kudyapi boat-lute, palendag bamboo flute, layered over lush cinematic strings, harp, soft choir pads and gentle woodwinds, wondrous, peaceful, mystical and adventurous, misty mountains and Lake Lanao at dawn, instrumental, no vocals, 96 BPM, D major pentatonic, 4/4
lyrics:
[Intro - kulintang gongs and palendag flute over misty strings, no vocals]

[Verse - instrumental, kudyapi boat-lute melody with harp and strings]

[Chorus - instrumental, full orchestra with kulintang ensemble, agung and dabakan, soaring strings]

[Interlude - instrumental, agung and dabakan rhythm, kulintang solo]

[Verse - instrumental, palendag flute melody, harp, gentle strings]

[Chorus - instrumental, full orchestra with kulintang ensemble, soaring strings]

[Outro - instrumental, kulintang and flute fade over strings]
